Container.Name: mtg-deck-keeper
Container.Overview: Photograph your Magic: The Gathering cards and get a counted, checked decklist. Photos are read by your own local vision model through any OpenAI-compatible API (llama-swap, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM), names are matched against Scryfall's card list, and low-confidence cards are flagged for you to fix. Supports OIDC single sign-on like Mealie. All settings below are optional: you can leave them blank and configure everything in the web UI under Settings.
Container.Requires: A vision-capable model served over an OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. llama-swap with a GGUF model plus its mmproj file.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Database, uploaded photos and the generated secret key.

Config.Name: Vision API base URL
Config.Description: Optional. OpenAI-compatible endpoint ending in /v1, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080/v1 for llama-swap. Leave blank to set it in Settings. If set here, it is locked in the web UI.

Config.Name: Vision model
Config.Description: Optional. Model ID as the server knows it; for llama-swap this is the key under models: in config.yaml (e.g. daily). Leave blank to pick it in Settings.

Config.Name: Vision API key
Config.Description: Optional. Only needed if your server checks API keys.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Optional. Public URL of this app, e.g. https://decks.example.com. Needed for OIDC behind a reverse proxy if the redirect URI shown in Settings is wrong.

Config.Name: OIDC enabled
Config.Description: Optional (true/false). Everything OIDC can also be set in Settings → Login & OIDC.

Config.Name: OIDC provider name
Config.Description: Optional. Shown on the login button.

Config.Name: OIDC user group
Config.Description: Optional. Only members of this group may log in.

Config.Name: OIDC admin group
Config.Description: Optional. Members of this group become admins.

Config.Name: Allow password login
Config.Description: Optional. Set to true to get back in if you turned password login off and OIDC is broken.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as.
